opening.argument: The presentation ties participation to buying a package that provides education and tokens, then promises rapid recovery of the investment: “you still need to get into the join a business by buying a package” and “return your investments within 5 months or even 5.5 months.” It instructs participants to “Build a two-legged left or right” structure and promises that “From first generation you'll get 10%,” establishing recruitment-based commissions across multiple generations. It further presents purchasers and recruits as miners—“we are all miners, we are miners, we are miners”—and directs them, “After that, we sell tokens.” Although the presentation assures viewers that the arrangement is not a pyramid, these paid packages, recruitment instructions, commission claims, and rapid-growth promises solicit investment and participation in a deceptive tiered structure rather than neutrally explaining cryptocurrency.
